name: upshift-ai-workspace
description: UPSHIFT AI — Adaptive Personal Development Platform Powered by Gemma 4

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "server,client" -c "blue,green" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.start: concurrently -n "server,client" -c "blue,green" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install
